Ninja Gaiden 3 - Razor's Edge.name: Ninja Gaiden 3: Razor's Edge
Ninja Gaiden 3 - Razor's Edge.summary: Ninja Gaiden 3: Razor's Edge is an enhanced port of Ninja Gaiden 3 that includes all downloadable content from the original title, as well as additional enhancements made to improve the game. The game can be considered an equivalent to the Ninja Gaiden Sigma games, as it enhances the original title.
